title: Design System: 心创云盘 (ShouYuLove Drive)

title.purpose: Main editorial H1 title (clamp 30px–42px / 400 weight) in solid warm alabaster #f4f1ea.

section.purpose: Workspace, denied-panel, and drawer sub-pane H2 titles (clamp 20px–22px / 650 weight).

heading.purpose: Guest open capability directory headings (20px desktop, 18px mobile <= 720px).

brand.purpose: Self-hosted Google Sans Flex + HarmonyOS Sans SC wordmark on .nav-brand (17px / 1.0625rem, 650 weight).

body.purpose: Lead descriptions, directory copy, file titles, and masked account numbers (17px desktop, 16px mobile <= 720px).

control.purpose: Hero CTA label, input fields, record row titles, and FileBrowser base size (16px / 1rem).

meta.purpose: Navigation links, account pills, standard action buttons, preset chips, FileBrowser items, and footer (15px / 0.9375rem).

floor.purpose: Absolute minimum font size at <= 380px viewports (14px / 0.875rem); sub-14px text is forbidden.

mono.purpose: Agent token values, HTTP curl terminal block, and record code prefixes (15px / 0.9375rem).

shadows.name: primary-hover
shadows.purpose: Crisp 1px warm rim paired with neutral offset elevation on primary alabaster button hover.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Zero-blur warm focus ring accompanying focused text inputs.

shadows.name: stamp-rest
shadows.purpose: Rest elevation anchoring #f6f4ee squircle icon stamps off the #05060b night sky.

shadows.name: stamp-hover
shadows.purpose: Crisp 1px warm rim and neutral offset lift on hovered visitor capability row stamps.

shadows.name: tile-dir
shadows.purpose: Rest elevation on #f6f4ee folder squircle tiles inside the root file list.

shadows.name: status-ok-ring
shadows.purpose: Crisp 2px mint online indicator ring in the topbar account pill.

shadows.name: status-warn-ring
shadows.purpose: Crisp 2px amber warning indicator ring for non-whitelisted sessions.

shadows.name: filebrowser-modal
shadows.purpose: Deep shadow framing FileBrowser modal .card overlays in branding/custom.css.

motion.name: ease-control
motion.purpose: Fast color, border, and fill transitions on buttons, nav links, inputs, and inline links.

motion.name: ease-row
motion.purpose: Hover wash transitions across open hairline file and capability rows.

motion.name: ease-drawer-reveal
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out reveal and chevron rotation on #admin-settings-drawer.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Universal transition and animation collapse under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

narrative.overview:
心创云盘 (`shouyulove-drive`) replicates the nocturnal architectural discipline of `Benchmarks' Last Exam` (`/zh/benchmarks/`): a `#05060b` deep-space canvas brushed with subtle starlight dots and indigo/umber nebula washes, `0.5px` structural hairlines (`--line: #1c1f2a`, `--line-strong: #2a2e3b`), warm `#f4f1ea` primary ink paired with `#fff3df` starlight glow, `#ff5a3c` emblem accent ticks, `#f6f4ee` ivory squircle icon stamps, and open hairline directories in place of boxed card walls. Public copy remains concise, human, and free of filesystem/ops jargon—never displaying `/srv/drive` paths or hash internals. Right beneath the editorial left-right header (`

心创云盘

`, plain-language subtitle, and `48px` `#f4f1ea` login CTA), `#drive-overview.overview` renders a quiet full-width two-column `0.5px` hairline band modeled directly on `Benchmarks' Last Exam`: left column `存储空间` (`7px` `#3ecf8e -> #fff3df` `` bar plus tabular `已用空间`, `剩余可用`, `总容量`) and right column `云盘概览` (aggregate file/folder counts plus live sync timestamp). All Unified Passport sign-in, auto-registration, and account-switching actions open an in-page floating `` (`ShouyuAuth.openModal`) right over `/drive/` with zero URL redirect. When an authorized member signs in, the guest directory hides immediately so `#view-console` places the open `网盘文件` hairline table right below `#drive-overview`, while administrative controls (`成员名单`, `空间扩展`, `Agent 接入令牌`) remain collapsed by default inside `
`. Every asset—including self-hosted `Google Sans Flex` and `HarmonyOS Sans SC` (`400 / 500 / 600–700`) WOFF2 faces, custom cloud-bracket SVG logo (`logo.svg` / `favicon.svg`), and `1.75px` UI icons—ships under a strict `'self'` Content Security Policy, while `branding/custom.css` brings the identical `#05060b`, `#0b0d14`, `#10131c`, `#f4f1ea`, `#d8d5cd`, and `#fff3df` palette into FileBrowser (`/drive/files/`).
keyCharacteristics: Deep-space `#05060b` canvas layered with sparse CSS starlight (`body::before`), stepped obsidian surfaces (`#0b0d14` / `#0e1119` / `#10131c` / `#151924` / `#222838`), and `0.5px` structural hairlines (`#1c1f2a` / `#2a2e3b` / `#3a3f4f`).
Warm alabaster ink (`#f4f1ea` / `#d8d5cd`) and cool slate muted text (`#a3a7b3`), ignited by `#fff3df` warm starlight hover rims and `#ff5a3c` cinnabar-orange brand ticks.

Signature `#f6f4ee` warm-ivory squircle stamps (`48x48`, `13px` radius for guest feature rows; `40x40`, `10px` radius for root folder tiles) casting high-contrast dark icons (`#07080d` + `#ff5a3c`) off the night canvas.

Variable typography combining self-hosted `Google Sans Flex` + `HarmonyOS Sans SC` (`--font` and `--font-brand`) and `SF Mono` / `JetBrains Mono` (`--font-mono`), preserving a strict `>= 15px` (`0.9375rem`) desktop floor and `>= 14px` (`0.875rem`) floor at `<= 380px`.

Sticky translucent frosted glass `.topbar` (`backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5)` over `color-mix(in srgb, #05060b 82%, transparent)`) with a `1px` starlight beam under active/hovered navigation links.

rules.name: The Starlight-Over-Obsidian Rule
rules.body: Deep-space `#05060b` and obsidian `#0b0d14`–`#10131c` layers frame warm `#f4f1ea` alabaster prose, leaving `#fff3df` glow exclusively for interactive focus/hover/beams and `#ff5a3c` strictly for emblem and stamp ticks.

rules.name: The Tactile Ivory Stamp Rule
rules.body: Directory tiles (`.file-row__tile--dir`) and visitor capability badges (`.report-project-icon`) flip polarity onto `#f6f4ee` warm ivory with `#07080d` strokes, anchoring visual hierarchy without boxing the surrounding `0.5px` open hairline rows.

rules.name: The 14px Minimum Legibility Floor
rules.body: Auxiliary labels, navigation items, chips, buttons, and FileBrowser rows hold `0.9375rem` (`15px`) on desktop and never drop below `--type-meta: 0.875rem` (`14px`) inside `@media (max-width: 380px)`—zero sub-`14px` text anywhere.

rules.name: The Variable Font & Tabular Discipline
rules.body: `Google Sans Flex` and `HarmonyOS Sans SC` drive headings (`450` / `650`) and body prose (`400` / `550`) with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Frosted Topbar & Specular-Line Rule
rules.body: Only `.topbar` uses `backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5)` over `82%` `#05060b`; secondary panels (`.denied-panel`, `.admin-drawer`, `.workbench-pane`) use flat obsidian fills, `0.5px` `#2a2e3b` borders, and subtle warm top-edge specular glints instead of frosted glass.

dos: Do anchor every view on `#05060b` deep-space canvas, `#0b0d14`–`#10131c` obsidian panels, `0.5px` `#1c1f2a` / `#2a2e3b` hairlines, `#f4f1ea` ink, and `#fff3df` warm starlight focus/hover glow.
Do keep `.topbar` sticky translucent glass (`backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5)`) with `1px` warm underline beams, while keeping secondary panels flat obsidian with `0.5px` strokes.

Do spotlight folders and visitor capability entries using `#f6f4ee` warm-ivory squircle stamps (`13px` and `10px` radius) with `#07080d` and `#ff5a3c` accents, keeping directory rows borderless with open hairlines.

Do enforce `Google Sans Flex` + self-hosted `HarmonyOS Sans SC`, `1.0625rem` (`17px`) desktop body copy, `0.9375rem` (`15px`) buttons/nav/metadata, and the `0.875rem` (`14px`) absolute mobile floor (`<= 380px`).

Do keep `branding/custom.css` synchronized pixel-for-token with `#05060b`, `#0b0d14`, `#f4f1ea`, `#d8d5cd`, `#fff3df`, `#3ecf8e`, and `#ff6b5e`, and collapse transitions to `0.01ms` under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
donts: Don't box directory rows (`.report-entry`, `.file-row`, `.record-row`) inside full card borders or drop shadows—preserve open `0.5px` hairline rows on `#05060b`.

Don't render any text smaller than `0.875rem` (`14px`) or place eyebrow/kicker labels above `

心创云盘

`.
Don't expose capacity GB metrics, ports, or server filesystem paths (`/srv/drive`) in the public visitor hero or capability directory.
Don't apply `backdrop-filter` blur to `.denied-panel`, `.admin-drawer`, `.workbench-pane`, or `.file-row`—reserve glassmorphism strictly for `.topbar`.
Don't reference external CDN fonts, icon libraries, or inline `<script>`/`<style>` blocks that break the strict `'self'` Content Security Policy.
